The '''White Zone''' was a part of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Built on the site of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] garrison, the White Zone was patrolled by numerous [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops.<ref name="Mask of the Pirate Queen" />
